rows.label: qst703001_msg0001
rows.name:
Everyone, I'm terribly sorry, but
could I ask a favor of you?

rows.label: qst703001_msg0002
rows.name:
While Yuugo-sama is away on campaign
with Adel-sama...

rows.label: qst703001_msg0003
rows.name:
I've arranged to meet with
a special envoy from Gula.

rows.label: qst703001_msg0004
rows.name:
Our Superbian Divine Beast has been
showing signs of decline...

rows.label: qst703001_msg0005
rows.name:
We plan to exchange views on the
future of both our countries.

rows.label: qst703001_msg0006
rows.name:
Our conference was to be aboard this
Royal Ship, and the envoy was to come
from the White Chair in Gula...

rows.label: qst703001_msg0008
rows.name:
To get here from the White
Chair, it's necessary to pass
through the Deep Hoary Weald...

rows.label: qst703001_msg0009
rows.name:
It's a dangerous place... Something
may have happened to the envoy.

rows.label: qst703001_msg0010
rows.name:
But our army has no soldiers strong
enough to search the Deep Hoary Weald.

rows.label: qst703001_msg0011
rows.name:
Therefore, I thought that I might
burden you with this request.

rows.label: qst703001_msg0012
rows.name:
Please, go to the Deep Hoary Weald and
search for the Gulan special envoy.

rows.label: qst703001_msg0013
rows.name:
I'm sorry to ask when you're busy,
but please help us.

rows.label: qst703001_msg0101
rows.name:
Now that I think of it, I should
probably have sent him to Bazuain...
